result:
All 14 queries ran against the input files and gave sensible answers. The last four (U11, U12, U13 and U14) are the ones I checked least against the raw data.

- **U1:** ["adam","Bob","Zoe"].
- **U2:** 69.93.
- **U3:** {ann 2, bob 2, dee 1}.
- **U4:** ["axios","eslint","express","jest"].
- **U5:** abe, kim and lee, each with 2 open issues.
- **U6:** ["bug","chore","docs","perf","typo","ui","urgent"].
- **U7:** 94.
- **U8:** ["/api/items","/api/users"].
- **U9:** {tools 16.08, toys 8.13, decor 14.5}.
- **U10:** ["Vase","Sprocket","Widget"].
- **U11:** api 8080, auth 9000, db 8080, mail 8080, web 80. Cache is excluded because it is disabled.
- **U12:** {u1 "logout", u2 "purchase", u3 "login"}.
- **U13:** "CACHE-01,DB-01,WEB-01,WEB-02".
- **U14:** {count 6, longest ["elderberry","banana"]}.

U9 and U3 print their keys as keywords, because the language builds map keys that way.

U1: ["adam","Bob","Zoe"].
U1: /data/users | filter ~(allOf (/active | eq true) ~(at :address | coalesce {} | at :city | coalesce "" | lower | eq "berlin")) | sort ~(/name | lower) | map ~(/name)
U2: filter ~(/status | eq "paid") | map ~(at :items | coalesce [] | map ~(mulOf /qty /price) | sum) | sum | round 2
U3: filter ~(at :items | coalesce [] | count | gt 0) | groupBy ~(/customer) | map ~(count)
U4: [/dependencies /devDependencies] | map ~(entries) | flat | filter ~(/1 | startsWith "^") | map ~(/0) | distinct | map ~(keyword) | sort
U5: filter ~(allOf (/state | eq "open") ~(at :assignee | ne null)) | groupBy ~(/assignee/login) | map ~(count) | entries | map ~({:assignee (/0 | keyword) :count /1}) | sort ~([(/count | desc) /assignee]) | take 3
U6: map ~(at :labels | coalesce [] | map ~(lower)) | flat | distinct | sort
U7: lines | map ~(split " ") | filter ~(/1 | eq "GET") | map ~(/4 | take (count | sub 2) | parseJson) | avg | round 1
U8: lines | map ~(split " ") | groupBy ~(/2) | map ~(count) | entries | map ~({:p (/0 | keyword) :c /1}) | sort ~([(/c | desc) /p]) | take 2 | map ~(/p)
U9: lines | drop 1 | filter ~(ne "") | map ~(split ",") | filter ~(/2 | ne "") | groupBy ~(/1 | lower) | map ~(map ~(/2 | parseJson) | avg | round 2)
U10: lines | drop 1 | filter ~(ne "") | map ~(split ",") | filter ~(allOf (/2 | ne "") ~(/3 | parseJson | ne 0)) | sort ~([(/2 | parseJson | desc) /0]) | take 3 | map ~(/0)
U11: :d (/defaults) | /services | entries | map ~({:name (/0 | keyword) :v /1}) | filter ~(/v | at :enabled | ne false) | map ~({:name /name :port (/v | at :port | coalesce (d | /port))}) | sort ~(/name)
U12: groupBy ~(/user) | map ~(sort ~(/ts) | last | /type)
U13: lines | map ~(trim) | filter ~(allOf (ne "") ~(startsWith "#" | eq false)) | map ~(split "|" | map ~(trim)) | filter ~(/2 | split "," | map ~(lower) | contains "prod") | map ~(/0 | upper) | sort | join ","
U14: ["Apple" "banana" "apple" "Cherry" "BANANA" "date" "fig" "Elderberry" "cherry" "Fig"] | map ~(lower) | distinct | :w / | {:count count :longest (sort ~([(count | desc) /]) | take 2)}
